hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json|md)$' | xargs -r pnpm exec prettier --write || true

cmd=$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')).tool_input?.command ?? ''"); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&|(])[[:space:]]*yarn([[:space:]]|$)'; then echo 'This repo uses pnpm, not yarn: pnpm <script>, pnpm exec <bin> instead of yarn run -T <bin>, pnpm --filter <pkg> instead of yarn workspace <pkg>.' >&2; exit 2; fi
